parameters.content:
### 90 Errors
Two ways in: n8n hands over an uncaught crash, or a router lane hands over a failure it caught.
Both land in the same failures table.
Technical detail goes to whoever maintains this; the owner is told consequences, not causes.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO failures (source, workflow_name, workflow_id, execution_id, node_name,
  message, gmail_message_id, payload)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8::jsonb)
RETURNING id, source, node_name, message;
